## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. The page editor stops sending `requires`; the server stamps it

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-01T08:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** It was measured: an author who adds a plugin component to a published html page cannot publish, and the refusal names a key the editor never shows.

**Direction.** It is the card's own scope (the producer changes, the contract does not), confirmed:
- a `fromDraft` for `page` drops `requires` from the saved body;
- ⛔ no client-side recomputation of `requires`: the server owns the stamp (ADR-0080 §5), and a disagreeing hand-written list is still refused;
- **Pin:** a source edit that adds a plugin component saves and publishes, with the server's stamp naming it. A page whose source is unchanged is the control.

## Claim amendment: the file surface widens to the Studio Interfaces pillar's page save (same defect, second producer)

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ` · 2026-10-01T12:57Z. This amends the claim `5931404711`. The state and assignee are unchanged. ⛔ Not a new claim.

- **Why.** The dev report `5931919673` measured a second producer of this card's defect. `InterfacesPillar.doSave` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) calls `client.save(current.type, current.name, draft)` with the served draft whole and never reads `config.fromDraft`. A probe on the fix commit `09b0033813`, with the `page` `fromDraft` registered, captured the pillar's autosave body after adding a Kanban: it still carried `requires: ['ui']`. Pages open in that pillar from the Studio, and acceptance item 1 says "In the Studio".
- **The seat's answer** (the dev's option A; within seat discretion: the same card, the same defect, and triage's direction `5928148828` unchanged):
  - The pillar's page save serialises through the `page` registration's `fromDraft`, so the registry stays the single save serialiser both editors honour. ⛔ No second copy of the drop.
  - ⛔ No asymmetry hazard. The pillar applies no `toDraft` on load, so it must not apply a type's `fromDraft` where that type also registers a `toDraft` (`view`'s family fold is the example such a pair exists for). A page-scoped call, or a generic call guarded on "this type registers no `toDraft`", is the dev's choice, said in the PR and pinned.
  - ⛔ Still no client-side recomputation of `requires`.
- **Added file surface:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`InterfacesPillar.doSave`, page save body only), plus one pin in that surface's existing harness.
- **Serial constraints cleared:** read 2026-10-01T12:57Z. No open PR other than PR objectui#11382 changes `studio-design/` or `builtinComponents.tsx`, and no `pm:dispatched` claim names them.
- **Scope:** with both producers covered, PR objectui#11382's first line becomes `Fixes #11357`.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11382 (`Fixes #11357`), head `25db06c522`

`domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42` · 2026-10-01T13:52Z. Reviewer of record after the takeover `5932833214`. Route: direct acceptance. The draft PR is present with CI green, the dev's second report is absent, and the death is session-wide. The PR body is the report, and every line below was checked against GitHub or the PR head by git, not against the body's own account.

**Shape.** Draft, base `main`. The first line is `Fixes #11357`, and a scan of the whole body finds no other closing keyword. 5 files, +479 / −1 (under the 5000-line human-merge threshold). Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`, and no file outside the amended claim's surface.

**Path fork.** `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (objectui) answers NOT GOVERNED for all 5 paths, so the PR takes the merge-queue route. Clause ②: the path limb misses (no `packages/spec/**`) and the claim declares `no`. Both helpers, `pageSaveBody` and `interfacesSaveBody`, are module-private (a `git grep` for an `export` of either on the head finds nothing), so no published export, prop or type moves.

**Diff, read at the head:**
- `builtinComponents.tsx`: the `page` registration gains `fromDraft: pageSaveBody`. It drops only `requires`, returns the same object when the key is absent, and never computes one.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: `InterfacesPillar.doSave` sends `interfacesSaveBody(current.type, draft)`. Only a `page` goes through the registry's `fromDraft`, so there is one serialiser and no second copy of the drop. The page-only scope honours the amendment's "no `fromDraft` without its `toDraft`" guard, and a pin holds the precondition that `page` registers no `toDraft`.
- The registration is present wherever the pillar runs: `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts:311` imports `./services/builtinComponents.js` for its side effect.
- Other writers: a `git grep` for `.save(` over `packages/app-shell/src`, `apps/console/src` and `packages/plugin-*/src` on the head finds no third writer of a served page body. `runtime-metadata-persistence` is typed view / report / dashboard, `doCreateApp` writes an `app`, and the rest name their type literally.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/11357-page-save-drops-requires.md` gives `@object-ui/app-shell` a patch (its `package.json` has no `private`, so it is published), with user-facing prose. The `changeset-claim-re-read` note names `.changeset/6681-…md`'s sentence that the eager `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` statically imports `SuggestedBindingsPanel`. That stays true: this PR adds one import of `metadata-admin/registry.js` and moves no chunk. Console eager closure 3552.4 KB against a 3574.6 KB budget: PASS.

**Tests (the body's evidence, with its pins on the head).** Metadata editor: 4/4 red on base `0a3e5409fb`, 4/4 green, and 4/4 red again when the `fromDraft` anchor is ablated. Interfaces pillar: committed red first (`170eb4c835`, 1 failed of 12), green after `0823fd1f93` (12/12), and the ablation of the `interfacesSaveBody` call turns only the pin red. The publish pin uses the real door functions (`stampHtmlPageRequires`, `findHtmlPageSourceGaps`) from objectstack `origin/main` `f0cc16e8d5`, so the 422 reaches its assertions through the real refusal, not a hand-written one.

**CI, pinned to head `25db06c522`.** 43 check runs. `Lint` and `Type Check` concluded `success`, and so did every other check except three expected skips: `Test (coverage)`, the unexpanded `Test (coverage shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)` placeholder, and `dependabot`.

**Out-of-scope findings, one line each:**
- "The drop applies to every page kind": Acceptance notes. This is the ruling's own scope (the server stamps only html / jsx pages), not a defect.
- "A `requires` typed into the JSON view is also left out": Acceptance notes. The server stamps from the source, so this is the intended behaviour.

**Deviations.** None from the amended claim. The branch is 1 commit behind `main` (`8001068b9c`, the datasource editor, which touches none of these files). The merge queue rebuilds on the current `main`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `25db06c522505e65c661f82098a34e6522d05fe8`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card objectstack-ai/objectui#11357 (its body and all six comments, `5928148828` through `5932883731`), PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11382 (its body, its five-file list, and the net three-dot diff of the head against `main`, merge-base `0a3e5409fb`, fetched read-only into a ref this session owns), and the 44 check-runs on the head. The objectstack sibling clone was read, never run, for two contract texts the card cites: the page schema's `requires` description and the save door's `stampHtmlPageRequires` / `findHtmlPageSourceGaps`. Nothing was built, run, re-run or ablated. The dispatching seat's ACCEPT comment `5932883731` was read as a comment on the card; none of its conclusions is adopted below. Every line was re-derived from the diff or the head.

### ① Derived judgments

**The diff, hunk by hunk, and what each implies.**

1. `pageSaveBody` in `packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx`, registered as the `page` resource's `fromDraft` — RIGHT. It removes exactly one key, `requires`, from a shallow copy; a draft with no own `requires` comes back as the same reference; it never computes a list; the draft object is not mutated. The `page` registration gains nothing else (no `toDraft`, no `createDefaults`). This is the card's prescribed fix verbatim ("a `fromDraft` for `page` that drops it"), and the card's "not a client-side recomputation" bound holds.
2. `interfacesSaveBody` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, applied inside `InterfacesPillar`'s `doSave` — RIGHT. Only `type === 'page'` goes through `getMetadataResource('page')?.fromDraft`; every other type is sent as its draft. One serialiser, no second copy of the drop. The page-only scope honours the amendment's guard: the pillar applies no `toDraft` on load, and on this head no registration anywhere under `packages/app-shell/src` declares a `toDraft` (the only matches are the registry's type and comments), so `fromDraft` is applied where no inverse is owed; the new precondition pin goes red the day a `page` `toDraft` appears. The registry is filled by the package entry's side-effect import of `./services/builtinComponents.js`, which is how the pillar reaches it at save time; the pillar pin imports it the same way.
3. Every metadata-editor door is covered — RIGHT. `MetadataResourceEditPage` has one save function, `doSave(force)`, and in edit mode it serialises through `config.fromDraft`; the toolbar Save calls `doSave(false)`, the destructive-change dialog's force-save calls `doSave(true)`, and the Cmd/Ctrl-S keydown and the autosave timer both call through `doSaveRef`. `refusalProbeBody` applies the same `config.fromDraft`, so the issue paths are read against the body the save sends. `doPublish` sends no body. Create mode goes through `buildCreateModeBody`, which applies no `fromDraft`; that is outside the defect, because the server stamps an absent `requires` on its own.
4. The pillar's only page door is the leaf autosave — RIGHT. `doSave` is the `save` of the leaf's `useDraftAutoSave`; `doNavSave` writes `'app'` by literal; `flushNavSave` serves only the nav save. The leaf draft is seeded from `client.layered(...).effective` or the pending `getDraft` body, stamp included, so the defect's precondition in the pillar is exactly as the card describes it.
5. No third writer of a served page body — RIGHT conclusion, one misstated reason. On the head, every other `client.save(` under `packages/app-shell/src` and `apps/console/src` names its type by literal (`'object'`, `'app'`, `'flow'`, `'hook'`, `'permission'`) or is `EmbeddedItemEditor`'s PUT of an `object` parent. `runtime-metadata-persistence`'s `RuntimeArtifactType` DOES include `'page'`, but every `persistRuntimeMetadata` / `createRuntimeMetadata` caller on the head passes `'view'` or `'report'`; the one variable-typed call is `publishRuntimeMetadata`, which sends no body. `ResourceHistoryPage` DOES expose a per-event Rollback (`doRollback` calls `client.rollback(type, name, version)`, and the page passes `onRollback`), contrary to the PR body's "exposes no rollback" — but it sends no body, so it is not a page-body writer either. Immaterial to the verdict; named so the body's sentence is not re-read as a reading.
6. Accept-set change for html / jsx pages — RIGHT, and as ruled. Before: a served stamp travelled back; when it agreed the server re-stamped identically, and once a plugin component joined the source it was refused at publish under `page-requires-disagrees-with-source`. After: both editors omit the key, the server stamps from the source on every save, and the publish passes. This PR touches no server code, so the server's refusal of a disagreeing hand-written list (API, CLI, metadata files) is untouched; the card's "an AI that hand-writes a wrong `requires` still gets the loud refusal" bound holds at the door it names.
7. Accept-set change for every other page kind — RIGHT, within the ruling. The drop is unconditional on `kind`, while the door's `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS` is `html` / `jsx`, so for a `react` or record page an author-typed `requires` would now be left out of both editors' saves. The spec describes the key as "Plugin namespaces the JSX source references (validated at save and load)" — a derived key, not an authored one — and the card's acceptance item 2 says "whatever the served document carried". Not a defect; the PR body's first acceptance note is the right reading.
